How this edition was built

This is a curated pull from the full MANDUBRE Kitchen Manual, selected to fit sober, Optavia-conscious eating: lean protein and vegetable-forward dishes only. Fried items, sugar-heavy glazes, and rice/noodle-heavy mains were left out. A couple of recipes carry a small amount of honey in the glaze — swap in allulose or monk fruit sweetener if strict compliance matters, or treat it as an occasional exception.
